sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: This app does not collect any personal information. We do not require you to create an account or provide any personal details to use the app.

sections.heading: How We Use Information
sections.body: Since we do not collect personal information, there is no data to use or share.

sections.heading: Third-Party Services
sections.body: This app does not integrate any third-party analytics, advertising, or tracking services.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.body: No user data is stored on our servers because no user data is collected.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
sections.body: This app does not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected on this page with an updated date.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: If you have any questions about this privacy policy, please contact us at itsnateguy@gmail.com.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: This app collects the following information: Name, Email, Phone Number, and a message. This information is used to contact you to discuss the project. It is not used for any other purpose.

sections.heading: How We Use Information
sections.body: Contact information you provide (name, email, phone number, and message) is used solely to respond to your inquiry. It is not sold, rented, or shared with third parties for marketing purposes.

sections.heading: Third-Party Services
sections.body: XO Fun uses Google AdMob to display advertisements. AdMob may collect device identifiers and usage data to serve ads. Child-directed treatment is enabled under COPPA, which instructs Google to serve only non-personalized ads. For details, see Google's privacy policy at https://policies.google.com/privacy.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.body: Contact information submitted through the app is retained only as long as necessary to respond to your inquiry and is then deleted.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
sections.body: XO Fun is designed for general audiences including children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. The app is configured to comply with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA). For information on how Google handles data in child-directed contexts, please review Google's privacy policy at https://policies.google.com/privacy.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted at this URL with an updated date.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: If you have any questions about this privacy policy, please contact us at itsnateguy@gmail.com.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: BurnWatch does not collect any personal information. The app runs entirely on your device and makes no network requests. No account, login, or personal details are required to use the app.

sections.heading: How We Use Information
sections.body: Since BurnWatch does not collect any information, there is no data to use or share.

sections.heading: Third-Party Services
sections.body: BurnWatch does not integrate any third-party SDKs, analytics, advertising, or tracking services. All functionality runs locally on your Mac.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.body: No user data is collected or stored on any server. Any preferences you configure in the app (such as display settings) are stored only on your local device using macOS system APIs and are never transmitted.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
sections.body: BurnWatch does not knowingly collect personal information from anyone, including children under 13.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected on this page with an updated date.

sections.body: If you have any questions about this privacy policy, please contact us at itsnateguy@gmail.com.
